title: Decoding embedded bits
statement: Let $A$ be a type with decidable equality, let $e$ be an embedding of the Booleans into $A$, and let $b$ be a Boolean. Decoding the symbol $e(b)$ returns $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an embedding of the Booleans into $A$
replaced:
For every embedding $e$ of the Booleans into an alphabet $A$ with decidable equality
and every bit $b$, decoding the embedded symbol $e(b)$ recovers $b$.
